identificationModule.officialTitle: Cyclosporine + Eltrombopag/Hetrombopag + Romiplostim N01 in the Treatment of Newly-diagnosed Transfusion-dependent Non-severe Aplastic Anemia/ Severe Aplastic Anemia

descriptionModule.briefSummary:
This study aimed to explore the efficacy and safety of cyclosporine (CsA)

+eltrombopag (EPAG)/hetrombopag (HPAG)+romiplostim N01 in the treatment of newly-diagnosed transfusion-dependent aplastic anemia (TD-NSAA) and severe aplastic anemia (SAA)

armGroups.label: CsA+EPAG/HPAG+Romiplostim N01
armGroups.description: CsA 3-5mg/kg/d EPAG 50mg/d or HPAG 7.5mg/d Romiplostim N01 20µg/kg, subcutaneously, once a week

interventions.name: thrombopoietin receptor agonist (TPO-RA)
interventions.description: Eltrombopag 50mg/d, increased by 25mg every two weeks Hetrombopag 7.5mg/d, increased by 2.5mg every two weeks

interventions.name: Romiplostim N01
interventions.description: Romiplostim N01 20µg/kg, subcutaneously, once a week

secondaryOutcomes.measure: red blood cell (RBC)/platelet (PLT) transfusion independent rate
secondaryOutcomes.description: Proportion of patients who achieve red blood cell (RBC)/platelet (PLT) transfusion independence for 8 weeks or longer
proportion of patients with adverse events, according to CTCAE
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: through study completion, an average of 1 year
